execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."AppSetting" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ChatLog" (
  "audioUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isHint" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "materialId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "questionId" text,
  "sender" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text,
  "studentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toolCalled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "usedModel" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ExerciseSession" (
  "attemptNo" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "llmContext" json,
  "materialId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'IN_PROGRESS' NOT NULL,
  "studentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalScore" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Material" (
  "content" json NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "difficulty" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "materialLlmContext" text,
  "order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subTopicId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MaterialProgress" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "materialId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'IN_PROGRESS' NOT NULL,
  "studentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalScore" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Question" (
  "answers" json,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "evaluationParameters" json,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "learningObjective" text,
  "materialId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "questionLlmContext" text,
  "questionUi" json,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."QuestionProgress" (
  "attemptCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hintsUsed" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isPassed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "masteryScore" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "needsTeacherIntervention" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "questionId" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "studentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "teacherFeedback" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SessionQuestionResult" (
  "attemptCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "feedback" text,
  "hintsUsed" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPassed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "masteryScore" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "questionId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SubTopic" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "thumbnail" text,
  "topicId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Topic" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "thumbnail" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "grade" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isAdmin" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "levelMaterialId" int4,
  "levelSetAt" timestamptz,
  "levelSetBy" int4,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
